units.source_text: 后来她竟然变成了另一个人。

en.t: Afterward, she had somehow become a different person.

units.source_text: 大概是还到石阶尽头的有为子再次背叛了我，背叛了我们。

en.t: Perhaps Uiko, having returned to the end of the stone steps, had betrayed me again, betrayed us.

units.source_text: 方才的她既不完全拒绝世界，也不完全接受世界。

en.t: The woman she had been moments before neither rejected the world completely nor accepted it completely.

units.source_text: 只是屈身于爱欲的秩序，为了一个男人而失身。

en.t: She had merely submitted to the order of desire and given herself up for the sake of one man.
